_comment: Look and feel of BP_Ship_Wayfarer, applied by Tools/Assets/import_ship.py after the size-based values from the manifest (everything here wins). Flight numbers from Wayfarer_spec.json. Exterior v2 (24. 9. 2026): built straight from the approved drawing (Tools/Blender/hs_build_ship.py + hs_assemble_ship.py), one flat material per paint zone, no AI texture. The interior (hs_interior.py, 25. 9. 2026) replaces the placeholder cockpit.

pawn._comment_gear: Modelled gear (SM_Ship_Wayfarer_Gear): collision hulls reach down to the pads, so gear_extension_cm is 0; stowed, the legs rise 100 cm (layout: belly -0.6 m, pads -1.6 m).
pawn._comment_cockpit: The interior (hs_interior.py) replaces the placeholder cockpit: seat, consoles and the dashboard with the four screens (24. 9. 2026).
pawn._comment_canopy: The canopy glass stays in the pilot's view (author 26. 9. 2026: a weak reflection from the cockpit, a strong one outside - MPC_ShipView); from inside it is nearly clear (OpacityInside 0.15).
pawn._exposure_8_10: author 8. 10. 2026: the cockpit too dark in the game, the photo mode's look wanted - -0.2 -> +0.8 EV (screens 2.05 -> 1.03 to keep their brightness)
pawn._comment_exposure: Concept A (25. 9. 2026): the painted cockpit must read as a form by day and by night, so the cockpit view is 0.5 EV brighter than the Vanguard's -0.7; the screens' emissive strength drops by the same 2^0.5 (2.9 -> 2.05) so they keep their brightness.
pawn._comment_light_color: 7. 10. 2026: warm neutral (was the C++ default 0.85/0.92/1.0): under the cool key light and the blue screens every cockpit material read the same steel blue-grey (critic, three rounds) - SC's Aurora cockpit is lit warm-white
pawn._comment_fill: 7. 10. 2026: a soft warm fill below and ahead of the eye - the lower dash and the console heads sank into black from the seat (critic)

camera_boom._comment: About 1.3 x the length (1. 10. 2026; was 0.8 x, 1750): at 0.8 x the fins and pods, 9 m from the camera, filled the frame edge to edge and the player saw only the spine (exterior review 30. 9.). SC's chase view shows the whole ship at ~40 % of the width. The wheel still zooms (CameraZoom x this).

cockpit_displays._comment: The displays' glow on the cockpit around them (rect lights at the Display_* sockets, UCockpitDisplayComponent). state_rate_hz 5: the figures change five times a second, so temporal AA (TSR) settles on each number and it reads sharp (the Vanguard's finding, 19. 9. 2026).
cockpit_displays._light_7_10: 7. 10. 2026: 12 -> 7 cd - the blue screen glow tinted the whole cockpit steel blue (critic)
cockpit_displays._light_colour: 7. 10. 2026: less saturated than the C++ 0.4/0.75/1 - the seat and the frames took the screens' blue

materials._comment: Hard-surface exterior: one slot per paint zone, flat colours on the hull master (linear), the panel grooves, bevels and kit greebles carry the detail. Glass is the translucent master.

MI_Ship_Wayfarer_Paint._comment: Layered paint with an Origin-like clear coat (author 24. 9. 2026): livery A (graphite saddle, orange stripe), panel variation (tone, roughness, 8 % bare-metal and 5 % carbon panels, UV1 panel ids), clear coat 1 / 0.05. Author chose livery A (24. 9. 2026).
MI_Ship_Wayfarer_Paint._wear: EdgeWear 0.15 (was 0.8) and the grunge in the clear coat's roughness: SC paint has no worn edges, the dirt shows in the gloss (starcitizenreference/ShipDetailing_VideoNotes.md, 26. 9. 2026)
MI_Ship_Wayfarer_Paint._livery_roof: 1. 10. 2026: the graphite saddle of livery A off (TopZ 9999): the author wants the roof plates in the primary paint - the chase camera sees mostly the roof, a dark roof made a dark ship

MI_Ship_Wayfarer_Paint._round3: 1. 10. 2026 kit pilot critic round 2: RoughVariation 0.45 (was 0.28), GrungeAmount 0.3 (0.15), ClearCoatRoughVariation 0.3 (0.12) - the dirt shows in the gloss; CarbonShare 0 (was 0.05): dark carbon plates read as holes in the roof
